name: wget Download Test
description: Downloads a resource via wget to measure HTTP/HTTPS download performance. Parameter 'url': the URL to fetch. Parameter 'output_file': destination path (use /dev/null to discard). Parameter 'timeout_seconds': per-connection timeout. Parameter 'tries': number of retry attempts.
specification: Fetch the resource at 'url' using wget, writing the response body to 'output_file' with a per-connection timeout of 'timeout_seconds' and at most 'tries' retries.

workflow.specification: Fetch the resource at 'url' using wget, writing the response body to 'output_file' with a per-connection timeout of 'timeout_seconds' and at most 'tries' retries.

name: iperf3 Throughput Test
description: Runs an iperf3 throughput test against an iperf3 server. Parameter 'host': iperf3 server hostname/IP. Parameter 'port': server port. Parameter 'duration_seconds': test length. Parameter 'reverse': when true the SERVER sends to the client (download direction) — use this for CCAnalyzer-style training so the queue-occupancy trace reflects the sender's congestion control.
specification: Run an iperf3 test to 'host':'port' for 'duration_seconds' seconds; when 'reverse' is true the server sends toward the client so the bottleneck queue fills under the sender's CCA.

workflow.specification: Run an iperf3 test to 'host':'port' for 'duration_seconds' seconds in reverse mode when requested.

name: h2load Website Throughput Test
description: Saturates the shaped bottleneck by fetching a website over HTTP/2 with h2load (pipelined requests), for CCAnalyzer's Top-10K measurement study. Parameter 'url': target website URL. Parameter 'requests': total requests (-n). Parameter 'clients': concurrent clients (-c). Parameter 'duration_seconds': optional time cap. Produces the bottleneck queue-occupancy trace for 1NN-DTW classification.
specification: Run h2load against 'url' with 'requests' total requests over 'clients' concurrent HTTP/2 connections to saturate the shaped link and capture the queue-occupancy trace.

workflow.specification: Run h2load against 'url' with 'requests' requests over 'clients' HTTP/2 connections.
